title: New airfield map in Call of Cubie — Claude and Codex wrote all the code
author: BlackberrySoft1082
selftext:
Hangar Nine is live in my browser FPS. There’s a whole airfield around the map now, with planes taking off and helicopters overhead. One objective is inside a C-130 that gets towed out of the hangar, taking everyone aboard with it. Still pretty wild to me that this runs in a browser.



Claude and Codex write 100% of the game code. For this map, Claude handled the map, aircraft movement and towing system. My side has been describing what I want, playing it, pointing out the specific things that feel wrong, and repeating that a lot. The amount of iteration between “it works” and “I actually like it” has been the biggest lesson.



[https://play.patio.fyi](https://play.patio.fyi) — free, no download or account. Desktop recommended; bots fill empty seats. I’d love feedback on the new layout and how it runs on your machine. If you’re also building with AI, what part has taken the most back-and-forth to get right?
